title: Current Good Manufacturing Practice and Hazard Analysis and Risk-Based Preventive Controls For Human Food and Food for Animals
archetype: food preventive controls and qualified facility records
source_verification_depth: Complete Supporting Statement A plus package; underlying cited sources not all independently retrieved. Specific corroboration recorded separately.

score_rationale.reproducibility: CFR-level population, frequency and time tables; rows and monetary role groups exposed.
score_rationale.provenance: 2023 median occupational wages cited; burden assumptions largely inherited.
score_rationale.segmentation: Human/animal food and reporting, records, disclosure requirements separated.
score_rationale.labor: Three role groups priced; generic doubling combines benefits and overhead without derivation.
score_rationale.item13: Blanket no capital or maintenance statement lacks implementation/system scope analysis.
score_rationale.item14: 50000 inquiry-response budget without workload or staff rates.
score_rationale.item15: Duplicate animal-food disclosure removed with quantified effect; remaining changes not fully decomposed.
score_rationale.validation: Agency experience and correction of duplicate requirement; little measured timing evidence.
score_rationale.consistency: Totals and labor groups reconcile; minor rounding from half-hour activities.

item13.rationale: No capital or maintenance costs asserted

item14.basis: Responding to inquiries; no underlying workload

assumptions: Record rows include 110-hour plan development, 730 monitoring events and 244 other checks annually.
Three role groups allocate all 7441862 annual hours.

reconstruction_issues: Federal inquiry cost is asserted without workload or compensation methodology.
Generic 100% benefit/overhead markup and blanket Item 13 zero lack specific derivation.
methods_worth_testing: Tie each activity to its legal requirement to identify duplication and support renewal corrections.
